data.action: 坐在课桌边缘，制服上衣完全敞开露出饱满雪乳，黑丝褪到脚踝微卷
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, desk edge framing
data.description: 【艾莉 · 放学后的空私人工作室·课桌上的私语】夕阳落尽后的空私人工作室门扉紧锁，艾莉坐在最靠窗的课桌边缘，成年礼服制服上衣扣子被完全解开，雪白的胸口因急促的喘息而剧烈起伏。她咬着下唇抓住你的领带——「门已经反锁了……在被其他人发现之前，快一点……」
data.lighting: dramatic warm orange sunset illumination casting long shadows
data.location: 放学后空无一人的私人工作室
data.promptProse: Seated on the window-side desk in the locked studio, she catches the viewer's tie with one hand and braces the other beside the papers, her black stockings gathered at her ankles. Low orange sunlight casts long desk shadows across the empty room.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 放学后的空私人工作室·课桌上的私语
data.animaCaption: One hand catches the viewer's tie; the other braces beside the papers on the desk.
